mapper.select: select * from tickets where is_used is false and owner_id=#{ownerId} and expiring_date>= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: update tickets set is_used=true, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where ticket_id=#{ticketId} and expiring_date>= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and is_used is false
mapper.insert: insert into tickets (title, description, expiring_date, owner_id, creator_id, is_used, inserted_at, updated_at) values (#{title}, #{description}, #{expiringDate}, #{ownerId}, #{creatorId}, false, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
